snippet.title: Void Breach Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Void is a Twin-stick space combat roguelite with 12 abilities, 5 reality-warping ultimates, and 20+ enemy factions that each fight differently. Permanent upgrades that stack across hundreds of hours. Quick missions, deep progression, zero runs wasted. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4276100/Void_Breach/
